description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of a sort option entry used within the Eclipse Ditto 'thingsearch' model package. It specifies sorting properties such as property path and sort order, providing factory methods for ascending and descending sorts.

classes.name: ImmutableSortOptionEntry
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the SortOptionEntry interface, representing a sorting configuration with property path and sort order.

methods.name: ImmutableSortOptionEntry.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableSortOptionEntry with specified property path and sort order.

methods.name: ImmutableSortOptionEntry.asc
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSortOptionEntry configured for ascending sort on the given property path.

methods.name: ImmutableSortOptionEntry.desc
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableSortOptionEntry configured for descending sort on the given property path.

methods.name: getPropertyPath
methods.description: Returns the property path used for sorting.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order (ascending or descending).
